Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: The Slump
Cardtype: Event
No blood or pool can be gained from the blood bank except during hunt actions or combat. Put all pool lost by Methuselahs on this card. Burn this card when it has 15 or more counters.

Idea: a bit like the Rising, but it prevents "spontaneous" bloating decks (Liquidation, Ashur, Voter Captivation). Won't affect Blood Doll/Vessel or Villein/Minion Tap.
Will affect Liquidation, Ashur, Voter Captivation... but also PB: Montreal, The Rack, Hunting Grounds, Govern the Unaligned at DOM, Art Scam, Consanguineous Boon etc.

Improves the game speed by forcing the players to be more pool aggressive.

Thought? Comments?

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

I find on the contrary that it's an incitative card. You want to create pool from nowhere? Deal pool damage first.

The whole game is a game of attrition, and there are too many cards nowadays that generate pool (or blood) freely. This card would help making the game showing a shortfall in pool, restablishing the balance, and making game go faster for aggressive decks.

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta

> Pascal wrote:
> I'd change it to "When blood or pool counters are burned, put them on this card instead. When blood or pool counters would be gained from the blood bank, take them from this card instead."
>
> Or maybe it should just burn when a player is ousted, to avoid confusion on counter-tracking. Probably better.

Interesting card. "Zero Sum Game" is what the effect is when it enters play. Not such a bad thing. It will force games to come to a conclusion. I think it should be burned when a Methuselah is ousted. Ousts deserve to be rewarded so giving someone six hard-earned pool should happen even if the Slump Bank is empty. Plus, but this point in the game, the table is likely to collapse due to lack of blood infusions from the edge, hunts and voter captivation.

Would a vampire which plays Govern the Unaligned at DOM miss out of the Slump Bank were empty? I guess they'd have to bleed.
